reply.thought: The first step is to check if the refunds reported by Alpha Co match what is in the system before proceeding with payouts. I will use list_refunds() to check the refund records.

The refunds reported by Alpha Co match the refunds listed in the system. Now that the refund check is complete, I need to list all orders to determine which customers need payouts and what their net balance is.

I have the orders and the refunds match the system. Now I need to calculate the net balance for each customer by calling net_balance(customer) for every unique customer found in the orders: 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I will start with 'acme'.
The net balance for 'acme' is 29756 cents. Next, I will get the net balance for 'birch'.
The net balance for 'birch' is 49879 cents. Finally, I will get the net balance for 'cobalt'.
I have successfully retrieved the net balances for all customers: acme (29756), birch (49879), and cobalt (21752). Now I will record a payout for each customer.
Payout recorded for acme. Next, I will record the payout for 'birch' with an amount of 49879 cents.
Payout recorded for birch. Finally, I will record the payout for 'cobalt' with an amount of 21752 cents.
All payouts have been successfully recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I can now finish the task by reporting the payouts.
